body:
## About the Riverside office Riverside is where Larkmoor Family Dentistry started in 2004, in a converted brick storefront a block from the river path. It has grown since then, but the front desk still keeps a bowl of clementines in winter. [Dr. Helen Whitfield](/team/dr-helen-whitfield) sees patients here most days. Riverside is also home to our implant and oral surgery care, with a 3D imaging scanner that lets us plan implants without sending you to another office. ## Care at this office
  • Cleanings, exams and family checkups
  • Dental implants, from planning to final crown
  • Extractions, including wisdom teeth
  • Dentures and implant-supported dentures
  • Whitening and veneers
## Getting here Riverside sits on River Road between Birch Street and the footbridge. If you are walking or cycling, the river path passes right behind the building, and there is a bike rack by the back entrance.

First visit? Arrive 10 minutes early so we can scan your insurance card and take a quick health history. See our new patient guide for what to bring.
